text:
claire: Quick heads-up — Acme Health (sales POC) needs a Private deployment behind their datacenter firewall. They want guaranteed no internet egress, support for BYOK, and a short security questionnaire answered. Can infra/solutions outline required network changes and a rough pricing delta for Dedicated vs Private?

raj: Do they prefer inbound or outbound connectivity? PrivateLink (interface endpoints) is inbound-init from our side; VPC peering/TGW is full-routed. Which one does their security team insist on?

claire: They said 'no peering across orgs' in the questionnaire, so leaning PrivateLink/Interface endpoints. Also they want to validate firewall rules before POC kickoff.

sam: ok — PrivateLink is fine. Minimal firewall rules:
```
- Allow outbound HTTPS (TCP 443) from their VPC to our interface endpoint ENIs
- Allow TCP 443 inbound to the endpoint's private IPs
- If using a NAT egress for updates, allow egress to S3 endpoints (HTTPS)
- If using dedicated capacity with a bastion, allow SSH 22 from our support IPs (opt-in)
```
We will provide the endpoint IPs pre-provisioned for the POC.

maria: pricing question — what delta should I quote? POC will likely run 2 weeks at low TPS, then 2 weeks at higher load. Any ballpark for Dedicated reserved vs Private (VPC) install?

sam: ballpark: Hosted Dedicated (reserved pool) = base infra + per-token; Private (VPC) one-time infra fee + monthly support + per-token op cost. For a two-week POC we can offer a trial discount and no infra fee. I'll get an internal estimate.

raj: BYOK yes — we can integrate customer KMS/HSM for model keys and audit logs. TLS enforced end-to-end. On the questionnaire: "Where is data stored?" — answer: customer data remains in their VPC unless they opt into our managed storage; logs for control plane are in our control plane (redacted) and can be shipped to their SIEM.

claire: can you draft a one-page req list for customer firewall team? I want to avoid multiple rounds.

sam: sending quick checklist — feel free to paste to customer:
```
1) Create interface endpoint(s) in subnet(s) used by app
2) Allow outbound TCP 443 to endpoint IPs
3) Allow inbound TCP 443 from customer subnets to endpoint ENIs
4) (Optional) Open SSH 22 to Support IPs for on-demand debugging
5) Whitelist our control plane egress IPs for telemetry (if requested)
6) Provide KMS ARN for BYOK
```

maria: perfect. I'll include that in the SOW + security answers. Also add: can we get a sample security questionnaire response for "export controls / data residency"?

raj: short answer: model inference happens in-customer VPC. No customer PII is exfiltrated by us; we can sign data-handling language in the contract. For export controls we follow our legal team's guidelines — I'll loop in compliance.

netops-bot: Ticket NET-4523 created for 'Acme Health POC - PrivateLink endpoints provisioning' — assignee: @raj

claire: thanks everyone. Next step: maria to send checklist + preliminary pricing to customer today; infra to provision endpoints and give IP list by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maria: on it. I'll cc legal for the questionnaire response. :email:
